name: CIS Controls v8
description: CIS Critical Security Controls — prioritized set of safeguards to mitigate the most prevalent cyber attacks against systems and networks. Organized into 18 controls.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
controls.description: Actively manage (inventory, track, and correct) all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure physically, virtually, remotely, and those within cloud environments.

controls.title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
controls.description: Actively manage all software on the network so that only authorized software is installed and can execute.

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.description: Develop processes and technical controls to identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data.

controls.title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
controls.description: Establish and maintain the secure configuration of enterprise assets and software to prevent exploitation.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization to credentials for user accounts, including administrator accounts, as well as service and application accounts.

controls.title: Access Control Management
controls.description: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges for user, administrator, and service/application accounts.

controls.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets within the enterprise's infrastructure.

controls.title: Audit Log Management
controls.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.

controls.title: Email and Web Browser Protections
controls.description: Improve protections and detections of threats from email and web vectors, as these are opportunities for attackers to manipulate human behavior.

controls.title: Malware Defenses
controls.description: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious applications, code, or scripts on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Data Recovery
controls.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore in-scope enterprise assets to a pre-incident and trusted state.

controls.title: Network Infrastructure Management
controls.description: Establish and maintain the secure management of network infrastructure to prevent attackers from exploiting vulnerable network services and access points.

controls.title: Network Monitoring and Defense
controls.description: Operate processes and tooling to establish and maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense against security threats.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Skills Training
controls.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence behavior among the workforce to be security conscious and properly skilled.

controls.title: Service Provider Management
controls.description: Develop a process to evaluate service providers who hold sensitive data or are responsible for an enterprise's critical IT platforms.

controls.title: Application Software Security
controls.description: Manage the security life cycle of in-house developed, hosted, or acquired software to prevent, detect, and remediate security weaknesses.

controls.title: Incident Response Management
controls.description: Establish a program to develop and maintain an incident response capability to prepare, detect, contain, and eradicate attacks.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Test the effectiveness and resiliency of enterprise assets through identifying and exploiting weaknesses in controls (people, processes, and technology).
